name: Kabocha Danshaku to Halloween
original_name: カボチャ男爵とハロウィン
source: A pumpkin-headed baron who lives in a mansion invites you to a Halloween party. When you arrive at the mansion, there is someone who claims to be a demon...?
translation: A pumpkin-headed baron who lives in a mansion invites you to a Halloween party. When you arrive at the mansion, there is someone who claims to be a demon...?
